usedFor: Campaign Monitor holds subscribers and Brevo holds your contact lists, so “New Subscriber” can run “Add Contacts To List”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Subscriber” in Campaign Monitor, then “Add Contacts To List” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: New signups carry an email address, and the action files it into a chosen Brevo list.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” adds existing Brevo contacts, so a subscriber not yet in Brevo may not be added.
